test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

SAME : WDOF :: LIFE : PLHF :: GOAL : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2ab27483492b14f195efc8f38a4e063622b383cd1612586de160b663cf0c215.png] 

**Given:**

SAME : WDOF :: LIFE : PLHF :: GOAL : ? 

**Logic:** (4), (3), (2) and (1) are added to the position value of the first, second, third and fourth alphabet.

SAME : WDOF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/195136b3544eb993a9ba314004d19e6f7b8248b152df32bfe5b91fdbc202207c.png] 

LIFE : PLHF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8692d020720f9018eb68311d61e0f8e3171c80663d550bcc4ba7e6de002b3e14.png] 

Similarly, for 'GOAL : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2575a3b3f919c07804a116853ed462d536ca353f1df59f9cbdc507e8d37cab55.png] 

Here,** 'GOAL : KRCM'** is the correct pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
